notable_absence.finding: This overview page states a hard numeric quota ('An organization can have up to 50 projects') with no corresponding limit/quota predicate anywhere in the current registry - unlike editions, support plans, or roles, quantitative resource limits have no ontology home yet. Not minted as a new concept/predicate for a single occurrence, but flagged for the coordinator in case this pattern recurs (e.g. cluster count limits, IP allowlist limits) in other batches.

cross_component_finding: This overview page is the shortest and thinnest of the 4 projects/ pages (28 lines) yet is the one all 3 other pages point back to as their conceptual anchor - a clean hub-and-spoke link structure within cloud/projects/, in contrast to project-roles.json's finding of a one-directional gap (nothing links FROM project-roles.md back to its own siblings).
cross_product_finding: All clusters must exist within a project ('All clusters must exist within a project') - this is a hard structural containment rule with no server/ RBAC or on-prem-cluster equivalent, reinforcing that Capella's organization/project hierarchy is a genuinely separate management-plane concept layered above server/'s data-plane model.
